research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register machine text of Executive Order 12686 (54 FR 32629, PDF pages 9-10 of the 1989-08-09 issue; sha256 506bacf9...), headed Executive Order 12686 of August 4, 1989, President’s Commission on Aviation Security and Terrorism, matching the census register row (1989-08-04). Text and inventory: the machine inventory has six scopes and stops inside section 3(c) at a page break, leaving out the rest of 3(c), section 3(d) and section 4 (the termination sentence). I corrected the inventory: section 3(c) now runs to the end of its sentence, section 3(d) and section 4 are added as scopes, and the other spans are kept (all spans in the registered text). All clauses belong to one advisory commission. Ending: Executive Order 12774 section 3(b) revokes Executive Order 12686, as amended by Executive Order 12705, effective September 30, 1991 (section 5). The report deadline in section 2(b) and the report-relative termination in section 4 are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.

savings.reason: Executive Order 12774 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the President's Commission on Aviation Security and Terrorism: its section 1 continues other committees, its section 2 concerns only those, and its section 3(b) revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the Commission.
